note: group circuits is the closest existing atlas group

description.zh: 磁通量变化越快，感应电压越大（法拉第定律）；感应电流的方向总要反抗这个变化（楞次定律），就像线圈转动发电时，磁通量一圈一圈周期变化，电压也就成了交流。偶极子近似的教学模型，不含自感与电阻。
description.en: The faster the magnetic flux changes, the larger the induced voltage (Faraday's law); the induced current always acts to oppose that change (Lenz's law). Spin a coil and its flux varies periodically, so the voltage comes out as alternating current. A dipole-approximation teaching model without self-inductance or resistance.

label.zh: 电压是磁通量的变化率
label.en: Voltage is the rate of change of flux

reason.zh: 磁通量变化越快，感应电动势越大——导数就是“变化快慢”的量度，所以法拉第定律写成 ε = −N dΦ/dt：它量的正是磁通量被推着走的速度。
reason.en: The faster the flux changes, the larger the induced emf — a derivative is exactly the measure of 'how fast it changes', so Faraday's law is written ε = −N dΦ/dt: it measures the speed at which the flux is being pushed.

label.en: A spinning coil gives a sine

reason.zh: 匀速转动使磁通量按余弦变化，感应电动势是同频率的正弦波。
reason.en: Uniform rotation makes the flux a cosine, so the emf is a sine at the same frequency.

reason.zh: 电场页的电场来自静止电荷、有势可循；感应电动势同样是电场在回路上的推动，却绕圈不回头——感应把“电场”从有势推广到了无势。
reason.en: The electric-fields lesson's field comes from still charges and has a potential; induced emf is equally an electric push around a loop, but it circles without returning — induction extends the 'electric field' from having a potential to not having one.

title.zh: 变化的磁场怎样变成电压？
title.en: How does a changing magnetic field become a voltage?

ask.zh: 磁通量变化率就是电压——磁通量变化越快，电压越大还是越小？这和导数有什么关系？
ask.en: The rate of change of flux is the voltage — faster flux change means bigger or smaller voltage? What does that have to do with a derivative?

ask.zh: 楞次定律说感应电流总要反抗变化——线圈转动发电时，感应电流的方向什么时候反向？
ask.en: Lenz's law says the induced current always opposes the change — in a spinning-coil generator, when does the induced current reverse direction?

ask.zh: 线圈匀速转动，感应电压随时间是什么形状？为什么是振荡的？
ask.en: A coil spinning steadily — what shape is the induced voltage over time? Why does it oscillate?

reveal.zh: 法拉第定律：电压等于磁通量变化率；楞次定律定方向——总反抗变化；线圈转动使磁通量周期变化，电压就是交流。
reveal.en: Faraday's law: voltage equals the rate of change of flux; Lenz's law sets the direction — always opposing the change; a spinning coil makes the flux vary periodically, so the voltage alternates.
